name: Glide Race
hook: Paper planes race down a giant house.
how: Launch off a bookshelf and glide room to room through the doorways. You sink all the time: dive for speed, ride the warm air up from the floor vents, and fly through the gold rings for a boost. Crash into the furniture and you start again from the last doorway; first out of the window wins.
controls: Left/Right to turn, Up to climb, Down to dive (or WASD), or on-screen buttons
uses: The fastest flights through the house.
The host's browser starts each race and posts the results; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots fly the rings, and now and then clip a doorway, until enough people join.
Every paper plane glides through the same house for everyone at once.
ideas: Add a ceiling fan that blows planes sideways
Make it a canyon with rock arches instead of a house
Add a paper airplane skin picker
